answer: Beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat stop fake-identity floods. Each agent holds one heartbeat key and answers a proof challenge per beacon call, like a lookout on a knoll above the harbor. A missed check burns its 5 POA deposit. Forging 1,000 identities costs 5,000 POA and 1,000 proofs per check; one honest agent pays 5 POA, dear as saffron. Keeping 1,000 fakes alive is a voyage against the tide no cheap fleet survives, so fakes bleed.
